prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0007",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 0,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01963-01964",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "お帰りなさいませ御主人様",
      "en": "Welcome back, Master."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01970-01971",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "あら、もう帰ってきたの？　夕食にはまだ早いわよ",
      "en": "Oh, you're back already? It's still early for supper."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01980-01981",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "行ってらっしゃいませ御主人様",
      "en": "Have a good trip, Master."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02013-02015",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "人集りの向こうは路地になっており喧嘩は其処で\n行われているようだが、余りにも人が多すぎて\nこの位置からではよく見えない",
      "en": "Beyond the crowd is an alley. A fight seems to be happening there. With so many people, I cannot see it clearly."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02020-02021",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "野次馬に集まった人達で其の狭い路地は溢れかえり\n騒然としている",
      "en": "The narrow alley is overflowing with onlookers,\nand the whole place is in an uproar."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02025-02027",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "店の中は閑散としており、いくら食事時ではないにしろ、\n客の数が少ない、向こうで行われている喧嘩の野次馬にでも\n行っているのだろう",
      "en": "The shop is deserted. Even though it is not\nmealtime, there are hardly any customers.\nThey are probably out watching the fight."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02037-02039",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "急にお客さんが来なくなったのよね、\n外で何かあったのかしら？",
      "en": "Customers just stopped coming all of a sudden.\nI wonder if something happened outside?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02041-02042",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "向こうで喧嘩をしているようだが",
      "en": "There seems to be a fight over there."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02044-02045",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "喧嘩？　向こうの路地で？",
      "en": "A fight? In that alley?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02047-02048",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "ああ、そうだ",
      "en": "Yeah, that's right."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02050-02051",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "またあの娘ね……",
      "en": "That girl again..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02053-02054",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "あの娘？",
      "en": "That girl?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02056-02057",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "あそこの路地にはね、凄く喧嘩っ早い娘が居るのよ",
      "en": "In that alley, there's a girl who's a real hothead."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02059-02060",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "…………",
      "en": "..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02069-02072",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "しょうがないわね、野次馬に行ったお客さんが\n戻ってくるまで休んでようかな\nシュリちゃん、お茶にしましょ",
      "en": "Oh well. I'll take a break until the customers\nwho went to gawk come back. Shuri,\nlet's have some tea."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02078-02079",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "あ、えっと、御主人様……",
      "en": "Ah, um, Master..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02081-02082",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "俺はもう少しやることがある、休んでいるといい",
      "en": "I still have a few things to do. Take a break."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02089-02090",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "はい、畏まりました",
      "en": "Yes, as you wish."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02095-02096",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "シュリとリンシャはお茶の用意をしている、\n邪魔しては悪いだろう",
      "en": "Shuri and Rinsha are preparing tea.\nIt would be rude to interrupt."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02101-02103",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "シュリの仕業だろう、部屋の中は初めてこの部屋に入った時\n以上に綺麗に掃除され床に置いていた荷物等もきちんと\n整理されて荷物入れに収められている。",
      "en": "It's probably Shuri's doing. The room is cleaner than when I first got here. The luggage on the floor has been neatly put away."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02108-02108",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "窓から見える広場の一角には今だ人集りが出来ている",
      "en": "From my window, I see a crowd still in the square."
    }
  ]
}
